Results.ReviewText: The Spirit is the perfect size for grilling for 2-8 people without needing to cook in shifts. It was easy to put together - took 2 hours and is excellent quality. It heats up faster than the larger grills and stores away easily. If you’re between the Genesis and Spirit, go with the Spirit. It looks small but it gets the job done. This is my 3rd Webber in 35 years of buying grills. Always buy a Weber! They beat the pants off the cheap brands!
Results.Title: Always Buy A Webber.

Good temperature control and even heat distribution.  An all around great grill with Weber quality and performance.  I own a Weber Genesis 330 since 2013 at my Florida home and was hoping this smaller Weber would perform as well and last as long  So far so good! 44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
